identity.title: Private Production Control Center — Read-Only Serving
identity.objective: Ship a default-off, one-process loopback production React/FastAPI Control Center and disabled dedicated nonroot systemd template, reusing existing exact-SHA release and SSH-only host substrate with private tailnet activation separately authorized; no extra commands, auth, product access or capital.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CC-PROD-01 to remove optional SPA route serving and its disabled unit template. Existing 31 APIs, local cockpit startup, immutable tracked releases, base bootstrap, SSH-only firewall and canonical stores remain unchanged. No host or tailnet rollout, persistent product/economic state migration, account access, orders or capital.
